narr: Deep monsoon moisture over Arizona and a weak upper level wave of low pressure moving over the state form the south helped trigger strong thunderstorms and very heavy rain.
ev: The Hot Na Na Wash in Marble Canyon (16.5 miles down the Colorado River from Less Ferry) experienced a major flash flood. A rafting party arrived at camp around 600 PM. The wash began to flow around 615 PM and ran well past midnight. The wash was raging at around 700 PM. The waterfall from the flood hit the rock layer below and splashed back up in the air more than 30 feet. Several bodies of farm large animals were in the flood.|Radar precipitation images indicated that heavier rain also fell in the Tanner Wash drainage to the east through south of Hot Na Na Wash. However, no reports from this area were received.
